short: Taehyoung Kim is a research engineer at Fraunhofer IVI working on robotic perception and aerial autonomy. His research spans video understanding, multimodal sensing, and semantic 3D mapping, with a focus on connecting research ideas to working robotic systems.

journey.title: Associate Researcher
journey.text: Research on aerial autonomy, from data curation and multimodal perception to mapping and on-board deployment. I’m also exploring language-driven mission planning.

journey.title: Research Internship
journey.text: Developed learning-based UAV path planning for my aerospace master’s thesis, “From Supervised to Reinforced.”

journey.title: M.Sc. Aerospace Engineering
journey.text: Thesis: “From Supervised to Reinforced: A One-Shot Deep Learning Approach to UAV Path Planning.” Grade: 1.3.

journey.title: Research Internship
journey.text: Worked on quadrotor energy modeling and fault-tolerant control using deep reinforcement learning.

journey.title: M.Sc. Power Engineering
journey.text: Thesis: “Fault-Tolerant Quadrotor Controller Design Using Deep Reinforcement Learning.” Grade: 1.1.
